Elements.Script: Value:AddToggle('MagicPower', {Title = 'Magic Power', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().MagicPower = V; if V then task.spawn(function() while getgenv().MagicPower do pcall(function() game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Remotes.GainMagicPower:FireServer() end); task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild('Stages'); local displayList = {}; local stageMap = {}; if folder then for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if child.Name ~= 'StageTemplate' then local wb = child:FindFirstChild('WinButton'); local bw = wb and wb:GetAttribute('BaseWins') or 'BaseWins'; local d = child.Name .. ' - ' .. bw; table.insert(displayList, d); stageMap[d] = child.Name end end end; getgenv().SelectedStage = stageMap[displayList[1]] or ''; getgenv().StageStates = {}; getgenv().StageSaves = {}; getgenv().PlayerOrigPos = nil; local function getWinCF(wb) local wp = wb:FindFirstChild('WorldPivot'); if wp then local v = wp.Value; return typeof(v) == 'CFrame' and v or CFrame.new(v) end; local ok, wp2 = pcall(function() return wb.WorldPivot end); if ok and typeof(wp2) == 'CFrame' then return wp2 end; if wb:IsA('BasePart') then return wb.CFrame end; local s, r = pcall(wb.GetPrimaryPartCFrame, wb); if s then return r end; return CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) end; local function saveParts(wb) local t = {}; for _, p in ipairs(wb:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA('BasePart') then table.insert(t, {p = p, CF = p.CFrame, CC = p.CanCollide, TR = p.Transparency, AN = p.Anchored, SZ = p.Size}) end end; return t end; local function restParts(t) for _, d in ipairs(t) do if d.p and d.p:IsA('BasePart') then d.p.CFrame = d.CF; d.p.CanCollide = d.CC; d.p.Transparency = d.TR; d.p.Anchored = d.AN; if d.SZ then d.p.Size = d.SZ end end end end; local function moveWB(wb, cf) for _, p in ipairs(wb:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA('BasePart') then p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.Transparency = 1; p.CFrame = cf end end end; Value:AddDropdown('StageSelect', {Title = 'Select Stage', Values = displayList, Default = displayList[1] or '', Callback = function(V) if getgenv().AutoWin and getgenv().SelectedStage and getgenv().SelectedStage ~= '' then local sv = getgenv().StageSaves[getgenv().SelectedStage]; if sv then restParts(sv) end; getgenv().StageSaves[getgenv().SelectedStage] = nil; getgenv().StageStates[getgenv().SelectedStage] = nil end; getgenv().SelectedStage = stageMap[V] or '' end}); Value:AddToggle('AutoWin', {Title = 'Auto Win', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoWin = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; while getgenv().AutoWin do pcall(function() local sn = getgenv().SelectedStage; if not sn or sn == '' then return end; local st = workspace.Stages:FindFirstChild(sn); if not st then return end; local wb = st:FindFirstChild('WinButton'); if not wb then return end; local ch = lp.Character; local rt = ch and ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if not rt then return end; getgenv().StageSaves[sn] = saveParts(wb); restParts(getgenv().StageSaves[sn]); local tp = wb:FindFirstChild('TouchPart'); if tp then if getgenv().PlayerOrigPos then local r2 = ch and ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if r2 then r2.CFrame = getgenv().PlayerOrigPos end; getgenv().PlayerOrigPos = nil end; if not getgenv().StageStates[sn] then getgenv().StageStates[sn] = true end; moveWB(wb, rt.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)); task.wait(); restParts(getgenv().StageSaves[sn]); task.wait() else if not getgenv().StageStates[sn] then getgenv().PlayerOrigPos = rt.CFrame; getgenv().StageStates[sn] = true end; rt.CFrame = getWinCF(wb); task.wait(0.1) end end); task.wait(0.1) end end) else if getgenv().PlayerOrigPos then local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local ch = lp and lp.Character; local rt = ch and ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if rt then rt.CFrame = getgenv().PlayerOrigPos end; getgenv().PlayerOrigPos = nil end; for sn, _ in pairs(getgenv().StageStates) do if getgenv().StageSaves[sn] then restParts(getgenv().StageSaves[sn]) end end; getgenv().StageStates = {}; getgenv().StageSaves = {} end end})

Value:AddToggle('AutoRebirth', {Title = 'Auto Rebirth', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoRebirth = V; if V then task.spawn(function() while getgenv().AutoRebirth do pcall(function() game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Remotes.Rebirth:FireServer() end); task.wait(1) end end) end end})

Value:AddToggle('KillMobs', {Title = 'Kill Mobs', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().KillMobs = V; if V then task.spawn(function() while getgenv().KillMobs do pcall(function() for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if obj.Name:find('LocalMob$') then local hum = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid'); if hum then hum.Health = 0 end end end end); task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild('StaffButtons'); local items = {}; local itemMap = {}; if folder then for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do local n = child.Name:match('(%d+)$'); if n then items[#items+1] = {Name = child.Name, Num = tonumber(n)} end end; table.sort(items, function(a, b) return a.Num < b.Num end); local list = {}; for _, v in ipairs(items) do local key = tostring(v.Num); list[#list+1] = key; itemMap[key] = v.Name end; getgenv().SelectedItem = list[1] or ''; getgenv().ItemList = list; getgenv().ItemMap = itemMap; Value:AddDropdown('ItemSelect', {Title = 'Items', Values = list, Default = getgenv().SelectedItem, Callback = function(V) getgenv().SelectedItem = V end}); Value:AddButton({Title = 'Take Item', Callback = function() local name = getgenv().ItemMap[getgenv().SelectedItem]; if not name then return end; local item = workspace.StaffButtons:FindFirstChild(name); if not item then return end; local o=item:FindFirstChild('Color');if o then local v;if o:IsA('Color3Value')then v=o.Value elseif o:IsA('BrickColorValue')then v=o.Value.Color elseif o:IsA('BasePart')then v=o.Color end;if v and v.R==98/255 and v.G==37/255 and v.B==209/255 then return end end; local tp = item:FindFirstChild('TouchPart'); if not tp then return end; local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local ch = lp and lp.Character; local rt = ch and ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if not rt then return end; firetouchinterest(rt, tp, 0); task.wait(); firetouchinterest(rt, tp, 1) end}) end

Value:AddToggle('AutoTakeItem', {Title = 'Auto Take Item', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoTakeItem = V; if V then task.spawn(function() while getgenv().AutoTakeItem do pcall(function() local name = getgenv().ItemMap[getgenv().SelectedItem]; if not name then return end; local item = workspace.StaffButtons:FindFirstChild(name); if not item then return end; local o=item:FindFirstChild('Color');if o then local v;if o:IsA('Color3Value')then v=o.Value elseif o:IsA('BrickColorValue')then v=o.Value.Color elseif o:IsA('BasePart')then v=o.Color end;if v and v.R==98/255 and v.G==37/255 and v.B==209/255 then return end end; local tp = item:FindFirstChild('TouchPart'); if not tp then return end; local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local ch = lp and lp.Character; local rt = ch and ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if not rt then return end; firetouchinterest(rt, tp, 0); task.wait(); firetouchinterest(rt, tp, 1) end); task.wait(0.5) end end) end end})

local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild('Eggs'); local list = {}; if folder then for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do list[#list+1] = child.Name end; table.sort(list) end; getgenv().SelectedEgg = list[1] or ''; local function tpEgg(n) local e=workspace.Eggs:FindFirstChild(n);if not e then return end;local p=e:GetPivot().Position;local lp=game.Players.LocalPlayer;local ch=lp and lp.Character;local rt=ch and ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');if not rt then return end;if (rt.Position-p).Magnitude>15 then rt.CFrame=CFrame.new(p)*CFrame.new(0,5,0) end end; Value:AddDropdown('EggSelect', {Title = 'Select Egg', Values = list, Default = getgenv().SelectedEgg, Callback = function(V) getgenv().SelectedEgg = V end}); Value:AddButton({Title = 'Buy Egg', Callback = function() if getgenv().SelectedEgg and getgenv().SelectedEgg ~= '' then tpEgg(getgenv().SelectedEgg);game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Remotes.OpenEgg:InvokeServer(getgenv().SelectedEgg) end end}); Value:AddToggle('AutoBuyEgg', {Title = 'Auto Buy Egg', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoBuyEgg = V; if V then task.spawn(function() while getgenv().AutoBuyEgg do pcall(function() if getgenv().SelectedEgg and getgenv().SelectedEgg ~= '' then tpEgg(getgenv().SelectedEgg);game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Remotes.OpenEgg:InvokeServer(getgenv().SelectedEgg) end end); task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})
